_comment: The held-out app's key, in the same schema as demo-app/answer-key.json (npm run bench -- --app holdout). Nothing may be tuned against this app: do not read this key before writing lane briefs for it, and do not turn a miss here into an engine or skill rule. `defects` are planted and listed in README.md; recall is measured against them. `alsoReal` are genuine unplanted problems; `nonDefects` are things a run may report that are not defects. `match` holds case-insensitive regular expressions tried against a finding's evidence and title; every entry's title and `examples` must classify to it and no `counterExamples` may (bench-test). When you change the key, re-score every archived run: npm run bench -- --all.
